note: Decision slots the italki design system needs filled before it can execute a request. An agent asks only about the slots a prompt leaves open — see INTAKE.md beside it for the protocol and maintenance/scripts/intake.mjs for the reference implementation. `applies` decides whether a slot is relevant to this request at all; `answered` decides whether the prompt already settles it. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions, matched case-insensitively against the raw prompt.
objectsNote: A slot asks the same question of every request; an object decides what its answers can be. `must-have-data` asked of a teacher profile should offer the sections PATTERNS.md gives that page, not a blank line — and asked of an object this system has never documented, it should say so rather than invent a plausible list. `pattern: null` is that case, and it is the more useful answer: it tells the requester the thing they asked for has no contract yet.

slots.title: What are we building
slots.question: What is the deliverable — a whole page, a section inside an existing page, a repeated unit, an invoked surface, a flow step, or an enhancement to something that already exists?
slots.question_zh: 要交付的是什么——整页、现有页面里的一个区块、可复用的重复单元、唤起式浮层、流程中的一步，还是对现有内容的改进？
slots.why: It selects the row in the Scope Selection Matrix, and with it the whole assembly strategy.
slots.why_zh: 它决定走 Scope Selection Matrix 的哪一行，也就决定了整个组装策略。

slots.title: Inside the product, or standalone
slots.question: Does this sit inside the signed-in product, or is it a standalone page? Inside means it carries the authenticated shell — the workspace header and the sidebar; standalone means it does not.
slots.question_zh: 这是加在登录后的产品里，还是一个独立页面？产品内要带工作区外壳（顶部导航 + 侧边栏），独立页不带。
slots.why: It decides whether a shell is drawn at all, and a page delivered without one cannot be dropped into the product — the navigation, the account cluster and the whole left rail are missing. Drawn when it should not be, it fights the page that already provides them.
slots.why_zh: 它决定要不要画外壳。少画了，页面放不进产品——导航、账户区、整条左栏都没有；多画了，又跟已经提供这些的宿主页打架。
slots.feeds: PATTERNS.md Authenticated Workspace Shell; EXECUTION.md §9 Page Assembly Rules

any: 页面|详情页|列表页|区块|模块|板块|流程|步骤|页

options: inside the product — workspace header and sidebar
a fragment dropped into an existing page — the host supplies the shell
slots.default: inside the signed-in product, composing workspace-header and sidebar-navigation
slots.default_zh: 登录后的产品内，沿用 workspace-header 和 sidebar-navigation

slots.title: Whose view
slots.question: Whose view is this — the student's, the teacher's, both (switchable), or a logged-out visitor's?
slots.question_zh: 这是谁的视角——学生、老师、两者（可切换），还是未登录访客？
slots.why: Role decides the shell, the primary action, the permitted states and most of the copy. Naming a teacher as the subject of a page is not the same as building the teacher's view of it.
slots.why_zh: 角色决定外壳、主动作、允许出现的状态，以及大部分文案。页面讲的是老师，不等于做的是老师看到的那一版。

any: 学生(端|视角|侧|的视角)|学员(端|视角|侧)

slots.title: Primary action
slots.question: What is the one action this surface must make possible?
slots.question_zh: 这个界面必须让用户完成的那一个动作是什么？
slots.why: The action hierarchy, the single red CTA and the success condition are all derived from it. A surface without a named primary action becomes a catalogue of information.
slots.why_zh: 动作层级、页面上唯一那个红色 CTA、以及成功条件，都是从它推出来的。没有指明主动作的界面，最后会变成一份信息目录。
slots.default: the action the object's page recipe already carries; stated explicitly in the interpretation block before anything is built
slots.default_zh: 沿用该对象在页面配方里已有的主动作，并在解读区块里写明

any: 预订|预约|支付|付款|搜索|筛选|排序|改期|取消|评价|评分|进入教室|提交|发送|联系|修改|上传|注册|选择|确认|举报|退款|续费|再约

slots.title: What must not change
slots.question: What must stay exactly as it is? Name the regions I should not touch.
slots.question_zh: 哪些部分必须保持原样？请指明我不应该改动的区域。
slots.why: An enhancement request that does not fence its scope is the most common way a working page regresses.
slots.why_zh: 改进类需求不划边界，是本来好用的页面出现回退的最常见原因。

any: 优化|改进|调整|重做|修改|改成|改为|换成|替换|去掉|删掉|新增|增加|加(一?个|上).{0,12}(到|进)

slots.default: everything outside the named region stays byte-identical, and the delivery record lists the unchanged regions
slots.default_zh: 指定区域之外的一切保持不变，并在交付记录里列出未改动的区域

any: 不要(改|动|调整)|保持不变|只改|仅改|其余不变|别动

slots.title: Object status set
slots.question: Which statuses of this object should the surface handle? One becomes the live state and the rest stay switchable.
slots.question_zh: 这个对象的哪些状态需要覆盖？其中一个作为默认展示状态，其余做成可切换。
slots.why: A status-bearing object read in one status only ships a page that breaks on the second-most-common row in the list.
slots.why_zh: 只按一种状态理解带生命周期的对象，交付的页面会在列表里第二常见的那一行上垮掉。
slots.feeds: EXECUTION.md §15.4 Scenario Coverage Matrix; PATTERNS.md lesson-card status set

any: 课程|课时|上课|预订|预约|订单|课程包|申请|支付|退款

slots.default: the live state plus the two statuses either side of it in the object's lifecycle
slots.default_zh: 默认状态，加上生命周期里紧邻它前后的两个状态

any: 待确认|待上课|进行中|已完成|已取消|已过期|已退款|未支付|已支付|爽约

slots.title: Must-have information
slots.question: What must be visible here for the task to work?
slots.question_zh: 为了完成这个任务，界面上必须出现哪些信息？
slots.why: Required data is what separates a real surface from a plausible one, and it decides which components are even eligible.
slots.why_zh: 必需数据是「真界面」和「看起来像那么回事」的分界线，也决定了哪些组件才有资格被选。
slots.default: the object's identity, the decision data its primary action needs, and the trust evidence PATTERNS.md already assigns to that object
slots.default_zh: 对象身份、主动作所需的决策信息，以及 PATTERNS.md 已为该对象规定的信任证据

any: 显示|展示|包含|要有|需要有|字段

slots.title: Layout target
slots.question: Which layout is the deliverable — desktop web, mobile web, or both?
slots.question_zh: 交付哪个布局——桌面 Web、移动 Web，还是两个都要？
slots.why: Task order, invoked-surface choice and the action bar differ per viewport; building both when one was wanted doubles the review surface.
slots.why_zh: 任务顺序、唤起式浮层的选择、动作栏的处理都随视口不同；只需要一个却做了两个，评审量也翻倍。
slots.feeds: EXECUTION.md §13 Responsive And Implementation Execution Rules

any: 手机|移动端|响应式|自适应|小屏

slots.title: Loading, empty and error states
slots.question: Beyond the default state, which states must the surface cover — loading, empty, error, unavailable, success?
slots.question_zh: 除默认态外，还需要覆盖哪些状态——加载、空、错误、不可用、成功？
slots.why: The scenario coverage matrix is validated at handoff; states decided at the end get bolted on rather than designed.
slots.why_zh: 交付时要按场景覆盖矩阵验收；状态留到最后再定，就只能往上硬贴，而不是设计出来的。

any: 状态|加载中|空态|空状态|错误|失败|成功|骨架屏|不可用

slots.title: Money and commitment
slots.question: What are the commitment rules — where do amounts come from, which currency, and what cancellation or refund terms apply?
slots.question_zh: 涉及承诺的规则是什么——金额从哪来、什么货币、取消与退款条款如何？
slots.why: Commitment logic is business meaning, not visual choice. A surface that invents a price or a refund window is wrong in a way the layout cannot show.
slots.why_zh: 承诺逻辑属于业务含义，不是视觉选择。界面自己编出一个价格或退款窗口，这种错误在版式上是看不出来的。
slots.feeds: PATTERNS.md Booking And Payment; EXECUTION.md §3.5 escalation

any: 支付|付款|价格|定价|退款|余额|优惠|折扣|钱包|账单|订单|课程包|取消

slots.default: every amount and policy line is a supplied, preformatted display value — the surface calculates nothing and submits nothing
slots.default_zh: 所有金额与政策文案都是外部传入的、已格式化的展示值——界面不做任何计算，也不提交

slots.title: Reference or reuse
slots.question: Should this match an existing italki page or pattern, or a reference you will supply?
slots.question_zh: 这个界面要对齐现有的 italki 页面／模式，还是你会提供参考稿？
slots.why: Reference-fidelity mode and rule-derived mode are validated against different things; guessing the mode invalidates the review.
slots.why_zh: 「对齐参考稿」和「按规则推导」验收的是不同的东西；模式猜错，这次评审就白做了。

slots.title: How interactive
slots.question: How interactive should the deliverable be — a static visual, a state switcher, or working interactions?
slots.question_zh: 交付物的交互程度——静态视觉、状态切换器，还是可用的真实交互？
slots.why: It decides how much of the behaviour contract is demonstrated versus described.
slots.why_zh: 它决定行为契约里有多少是演示出来的，多少只是写出来的。
options: switcher plus working overlays and validation
slots.default: a state switcher, with the overlays on the primary path actually working
slots.default_zh: 状态切换器，且主路径上的浮层是真正可用的

slots.title: Entry and exit
slots.question: Where does the user arrive from, and where do they land after the primary action succeeds?
slots.question_zh: 用户从哪里进入这个界面，主动作成功之后又去哪里？
slots.why: Entry decides what context is already known and need not be repeated; exit decides the success state.
slots.why_zh: 入口决定哪些上下文用户已经知道、不必重复；去向决定成功态长什么样。
slots.feeds: EXECUTION.md §2.4 Current Context, §15.2 Primary Task Path
slots.default: reached from the object's own list, and the primary action returns there with the new state visible
slots.default_zh: 从该对象的列表页进入，主动作完成后返回列表并展示新状态

any: \b(entry point|comes from|arrives? from|navigates? from|after (they|the user|clicking|clicked)|back to|returns? to|next step|lands? on)\b

slots.title: Content source
slots.question: Real copy and data, or representative placeholders?
slots.question_zh: 用真实文案与数据，还是有代表性的占位内容？
slots.why: Placeholder content that reads as real is how a demo gets mistaken for an approved decision.
slots.why_zh: 看起来像真的占位内容，正是 demo 被当成已定方案的原因。
slots.default: representative italki-plausible content — real language and course names, no lorem ipsum, no invented policy text
slots.default_zh: 符合 italki 语境的示例内容——真实的语言与课程名，不用 lorem，不编造政策文案

any: 真实(文案|数据)|占位|假数据|示例数据|文案(用|按)

slots.title: Locale rules
slots.question: Which timezone, currency and language rules apply?
slots.question_zh: 适用哪些时区、货币和语言规则？
slots.why: Time and money are the two values a global marketplace cannot render without a stated frame.
slots.why_zh: 时间和金额是全球化市场里两个必须先说清参照系、否则没法展示的值。
slots.feeds: EXECUTION.md §12 Data And Content Rules, §15.2 Localization Coverage
